_comment: Reference values for the Steamworks Launch Options page. No tool reads this file. Enter the values by hand. Names are placeholders until the depots exist.

launch_options.description: Windows 64-bit. Used on Windows, and under Proton on Steam Deck when no Linux option matches.
macOS. Electron produces an app bundle; the executable sits inside it.
Linux native, used on SteamOS (Steam Deck) and other Linux desktops.

fallbacks_not_enabled_by_default.use_only_if: Deck test shows Electron aborting with a SUID or user-namespace sandbox error. Record the reason before enabling it.
